Enables delegable-workflow adapters across diverse agents
Ensures hook portability independent of agent implementation
Under Bill 5 s. 18 (parent enabling power)
Coordinated with REALM-SI 11
items.summary: Amendment to SI 8 requiring agent-agnostic hook contract and delegable-workflow adapters for lawfulness verification.
items.title: [2026] REALM-SI 10 - Agent Lawfulness Hooks (Agent-Agnostic Amendment)

points: Amends REALM-SI 8 and REALM-SI 10
Requires best-efforts hook triggering (not perfect detection)
Balances security with practical agent operation
Under Bill 5 s. 18 (parent enabling power)
Completes agent lawfulness regime
items.summary: Amendment to SI 8 and SI 10 requiring each agent to make good hook triggering on best-efforts basis.
items.title: [2026] REALM-SI 11 - Agent Lawfulness Hooks (Best-Efforts Trigger Amendment)
